issue.title: Orphaned bob_dataview agent skill tells agents to run the removed 'bob dataview' command
issue.description:
The orphaned agent skill `bob_dataview` is still installed on apollo in seven provider
skill dirs (`~/.claude`, `~/.codex`, `~/.qwen`, `~/.config/opencode`, and three under
`~/.gemini`), e.g.
`~/.claude/skills/bob_dataview/SKILL.md` (mtime 2026-07-03). It tells agents to run
`bob dataview`, e.g. `bob dataview --format markdown --query-file /path/to/query.dql`.

`bob dataview` was hard-renamed to `bob query` in f401add ("feat(cli)!: rename dataview
command to query"), and the old name was not kept as an alias (README "Migration notes":
"The old top-level names are no longer registered"). The skill's source no longer exists
in chezmoi (as of 64246fcb only `bob_query` skill dirs exist, under every provider's
skills dir), so `chezmoi apply` never removes the stale installed copy. The skill still
appears in Claude agents' skill lists next to `bob_query`, so an agent can pick it and
hit a hard failure.

Found while consolidating the bob CLI command-tree research
(research:202610/bob_cli_command_tree_reorganization/bob_cli_command_tree_reorganization__final.md);
researcher cld first noticed it, and the lead reproduced it.

Fix options: delete the orphaned `~/.claude/skills/bob_dataview` on each host
(apollo confirmed; check athena and the Mac), and/or have chezmoi remove it
(e.g. a `.chezmoiremove` entry) so it cannot reappear. Optionally consider whether
bob should keep a hidden `dataview` alias for `query`, matching the
`task-status-setter` precedent.

task_type_fields.impact: Agents that choose bob_dataview over bob_query get a hard CLI failure; the skill appears in every Claude session's skill list on apollo.
task_type_fields.repro: Run 'bob dataview --help' on apollo: 'error: unrecognized subcommand dataview'. The installed skill's SKILL.md lines 3, 16 and 39 instruct agents to use 'bob dataview'.

issue.creation_reason: Found while researching bob CLI reorganization: a stale installed skill directs agents to a hard-removed subcommand, so agents that pick it fail; chezmoi no longer owns the file, so nothing cleans it up.
